cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you box our allotment photo, admit that summer wasn't wasted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We grew three carrots. I need the shelf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You got out of bed every morning to water those three carrots with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could put the photo on my desk at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you? And tell people that part when they laugh at the harvest.

mechanism: A grades the pupil gardening outcome by shared time rather than crop size and asks it to preserve that history publicly.
confusable: Not merely keeping an object: A wants the relationship and repeated company acknowledged as the real value.
comparison: Small harvest/photo versus failed ferry trip and chosen weekend.
seedUse: D81 carrots/photo/desk/mornings; S05 teacher corrects what counts as success.
